name: bicepflex-workspace
description: Source workspace for the standalone Bicep VS Code formatter and its compiler-backed Prettier engine.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && dotnet publish native/Bicep.Formatter/Bicep.Formatter.csproj -c Release -o dist/bridge --nologo && node scripts/licenses.mjs
scripts.lint: prettier --check src scripts "test/*.mjs" "packages/vscode/src/*.ts" "packages/vscode/test-host/*.cjs" package.json "packages/vscode/package.json" tsconfig.json README.md "packages/vscode/README.md" CONFIGURATION.md RELEASING.md CHANGELOG.md .github --ignore-unknown
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts "test/*.mjs" "packages/vscode/src/*.ts" "packages/vscode/test-host/*.cjs" package.json "packages/vscode/package.json" tsconfig.json README.md "packages/vscode/README.md" CONFIGURATION.md RELEASING.md CHANGELOG.md .github --ignore-unknown
scripts.build:extension: npm run build && npm run configuration:check && tsc -p packages/vscode/tsconfig.json && npm run build --workspace=bicepflex
scripts.check: npm run build:extension && npm run lint && npm test
